plan.archetype: Efficient area damage transitioning into poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring area damage to remove followers, sustained damage, upgraded weakness and efficient block, high entry HP, and two useful potions. Avoid prolonged Ritual scaling.
plan.summary: Secure efficient attacks and area damage first, then scaling defense and draw. Remove Strikes after obtaining replacements. Fight elites only with adequate damage, potions, and recovery; preserve health for the boss.

plan.archetype: Area poison scaling with dexterity defense and efficient cycling
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Footwork or Dagger Spray; bring sustained area poison, weakness, high HP, and useful potions. Remove threatening followers before Ritual scaling overwhelms defense.
plan.summary: Heal at the next fire and avoid the optional elite. Prioritize poison scaling, efficient defense, and cycling; remove Strikes. Use safer fights for Candy power rewards without taking unsupported powers.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity defense and banked energy
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Footwork, Noxious Fumes, and Accelerant. Secure efficient block, weakness, and two useful potions. Face Rocket during beam turns; account for survivor enrage.
plan.summary: Bank energy with Tears when essential defense permits. Buy scaling and block early; take one prepared elite after healing, then favor events, late shopping, and recovery. Remove Strikes and upgrade core powers when healthy.

plan.archetype: Area poison scaling with reliable block and efficient cycling
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Footwork or Fumes when safe; secure Accelerant, reliable block, and defensive potions. Face Rocket during beams; account for survivor enrage.
plan.summary: Heal now and avoid optional elites. Prioritize faster poison damage and reliable defense over additional slow setup. Remove Strikes, use potions against major losses, and bank energy only when immediate survival permits.
